correctness.rationale: For v-free faces the exact independence number is sum_i max(e_i,epsilon_i), and adjoining v replaces it with max(that,1+B). The first matching pairs all v-containing faces except {v} and leaves v-free faces with B=k-1. Each residual block has k-1 chosen middle vertices and local states 0,a,c; the first applicable a-toggle pairs 0 and a, leaving exactly one face of dimension 2k-3 per index subset. A directed cycle cannot change the v-indicator or the number/set of chosen middle vertices, and in a block c-states can only decrease; with those fixed the earliest non-c a-toggle can only increase. Hence the full matching is acyclic. Its critical CW cells force the stated integral wedge. Standalone face-poset verifier independently passed 30 complete parameter pairs.

value.rationale: For a natural canonical family with a cut vertex, the theorem gives the exact all-threshold integral homotopy type and sharp contractibility transition for every k>=4, beyond the edge/corner square-sequence framework. The binomial rank and optimal acyclic matching expose structural topology, and via Alexander duality determine total-cut homology. No finite extrapolation, arbitrary parameter slice, or Euler-only inference is involved.
